de1.P1.C1.ly_do: Chi $\frac{1}{x}-y$ chua $\frac{1}{x}$ nen khong phai da thuc; $\sqrt{5}xy^2$, $-\frac{2}{3}yz+1$, $0$ deu la da thuc.

de1.P1.C2.ly_do: $(x-3)^2=x^2-6x+9$; cac phuong an con lai sai he so.

de1.P1.C3.ly_do: $\frac{3\sqrt{x}+1}{3y}$ co tu chua $\sqrt{x}$ nen khong phai phan thuc; 3 phuong an con lai deu la phan thuc (da thuc coi nhu phan thuc mau 1).

de1.P1.C4.ly_do: Chop tam giac deu: day la tam giac deu va tat ca cac canh ben bang nhau.

de1.P1.C5.ly_do: Tam giac MNP vuong tai P nen canh huyen MN: $MN^2=MP^2+PN^2$.

de1.P1.C6.ly_do: Hinh binh hanh co hai duong cheo vuong goc la hinh thoi; B chi la hinh chu nhat, C thieu dieu kien, D la hinh chu nhat.

de1.P1.C7.ly_do: Thong ke so hoc sinh biet boi cua lop: phong van, lap phieu tham do la phu hop nhat.

de1.P1.C8.ly_do: Su thay doi so lieu theo thoi gian dung bieu do doan thang.

de1.P4.C1.ly_do: a) $(3x+1)^2=9x^2+6x+1$ (o thu 3); b) $(x-2y)^3=x^3-6x^2y+12xy^2-8y^3$ (o thu 4). Ca hai correctAnswer da luu deu dung.

de1.P4.C2.ly_do: a) DKXD $x\ne 2$ dung. b) Tai $x=2$ mau bang 0 nen phan thuc khong xac dinh; loi giai AI tu giai y b la dung, shortCorrect 'Khong xac dinh' dung.

de1.P4.C3.ly_do: 1a) $\frac{-9mn}{12mn^2}=-\frac{3}{4n}$ (o thu 4); 1b) $\frac{4y-xy}{x^2-16}=\frac{-y}{x+4}$ (o thu 4); 2a) $\frac{x+1}{x(x-1)}$ (o thu 1); 2b) $xy+\frac{xy}{x+y}(\frac{x+y}{x-y}-x-y)=\frac{xy}{x-y}$ (o thu 1, do $\frac{xy}{x+y}\cdot(-x-y)=-xy$). Tat ca correctAnswer da luu deu dung.
